verses.text: Ayik 21 yoch yukil uj, ix lolonxi Jehová t'ayin Hageo in tik.
Ix yalani to swal t'a winhaj Zorobabel yet' t'a winhaj Josué yet' pax t'a masanil heb' anima icha tik:
Ha ex eyilnakto swach'il yilji jun templo t'a yalanhtaxo, alek tato lajan yet' jun sko sb'o tik tiknaik. Tekan tze na'a to malaj jab'ok yelk'ochi tato sko lajb'ej yet' junxo chi'.
Ach Zorobabel, mokab' chab'ax a k'o'ol yet' ach Josué sat sacerdote. Mokab' chab'ax he k'ol ex chonhab'. Munlajanhek, yujto a in Jehová Yajal in t'a Smasanil, ayinek' heyet'ok.
Aynhej och Wespíritu heyet'ok icha ajnak wak'an kan in ti' ayik wik'annakelta heb' he mam eyicham t'a Egipto, yuj chi' manh ex xiwok.
Toxo wal ol in tzikub'tanhej yol yib'anhk'inal tik, haton satcha'anh, ha' mar yet' lum lum tik.
Ol laj wak' ib'xok masanil nación, haxo sb'eyumal heb', ol laj yik'kot heb' t'a in kajnub'. Ha in Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil swala', ol b'ut'jokel in kajnub' tik yuj sb'eyumal heb' chi'.
Ha in ay wik k'e'en plata yet' k'e'en oro.
Ha in Jehová Yajal in t'a Smasanil swala': Ha sniwanil yelk'och in kajnub' tik, ek'to ol aj sb'inaj t'a yichanh jun b'ab'el. Ha tik ol wak' pitzwok junk'olal, xchi Jehová, xin chi.
Ayik 24 yoch sb'alunhil uj, hanheja' t'a schab'il ab'ilxo yoch winhaj Darío reyal, ix yal Jehová t'ayin Hageo in tik icha tik:
k'anb'ej t'a heb' winh sacerdote tas syal ley yuj tas tz'ab'laji, xchi t'ayin.

Yuj chi', ix walan t'a heb' winh sacerdote chi' icha tik: K'inalok ay junok mach et'jinak jab'ok chib'ej, pichb'iloch t'a sti' spichul, yik Dios jab' chib'ej chi' yujto ix ak'ji silab'il t'ay. K'inalok a stitak spichul chi' tz'och t'a ixim pan, ma t'a junok wa'el toxo ix taji, ma t'a wino, ma t'a aceite, ma t'a junokxo tas wach' swaji. ¿Am yuj chi' yikxonhej Dios tz'ajkan juntzanh wa'el chi'? xin chi t'a heb' winh. --Ma'ay, xchi heb' winh t'ayin.

Ix walanxi icha tik: K'inalok ay junok mach manh wach'ok t'a yichanh ley yujto ix syam sniwanil junok chamnak, slajwi chi' syaman juntzanh tas tz'ab'laj ix laj kal chi': ¿Tzam ixtax juntzanh chi' icha yalan ley? xin chi. Ix tak'wi heb' winh: I'... tz'ixtaxi, xchi heb' winh.
Yuj chi' ix walani: Ha Jehová tz'alan icha tik: Icha chi' yaj juntzanh anima tik. Masanil tas sk'ulej heb' yet' tas syak' heb' t'ayin, junelnhej malaj swach'il.
Naek nab'i, tas eyaji ayik manto eyamoch he b'oanxik'e in kajnub' tik.

Yujto ha t'a yik chi', ay mach b'at ik'ankot 20 echlab'ok ixim trigo yalani, haxo sk'och b'aj molb'ab'il ixim chi' yuj, anhej lajunhe' echlab' ixim ayek'i. Hanhejtona' ay mach sb'at b'aj smolb'aj wino, b'at yik'ankot 50 ch'ub'ok yalani, haxo syik'ank'eta, anhej 20 ch'ub' sk'eta.
Ha in tik, ix in satel masanil tas tzeyawej yet' juntzanh yab'il yet' pax k'e'en sakb'at, palta maj ex meltzajkotlaj t'ayin.
Ha t'a jun k'u 24 yik sb'alunhil uj tik, ix eyak'em yich in templo.

Ha tiknaik, cham wal ol heyila' tas ol ex ajok. Wach'chom manhxalaj ixim trigo t'a yet'tal, ma manto yak' sat te' uwa, te' higo, te' granado yet' te' olivo, palta a tiknaik yet' yik ol b'eynhejb'atok, ol wak' wal in wach'k'olal t'a eyib'anh, xchi Jehová, xin chi.
Hanheja' t'a jun k'u chi' ix lolon Jehová t'ayin Hageo in tik.
Ix yalan icha tik: Al t'a winhaj Zorobabel sgobernadoral Judá to a in Jehová in swal icha tik: Ol in tzikub'tanhej satcha'anh yet' lum lum tik.

Masanil yipal juntzanh nación t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik, ol laj in sateli, ol wik'ankanel yopisio heb' yajal. Ol laj wekk'e pak'aljok masanil carruaje yik owal yet' masanil heb' ayk'e t'a yib'anh. Ol laj cham nok' chej yet' heb' ayk'e t'a yib'anh nok'. Junjun soldado ol xiklajcham sb'a yet' yetsoldadoal ajun yet'ok.

Ha in Jehová Yajal in t'a Smasanil swal t'ayach ach in chekab' Zorobabel yuninal winhaj Salatiel, ha t'a jun k'ual chi', ol wak'och opisio icha yopisio in sello, yujto a in ix ach in sik'elta, xchi Jehová, xin chi t'a winhaj Zorobabel chi'.
